description: Get one library model (model_ref from a search, or manufacturer + exact designation): category, ship area, page URL, manufacturer datasheet link if any, and the stored technical characteristics. Each value has source_document (label of the catalogue/datasheet it was extracted from; may cover a model series) and source_page. Values were extracted automatically and are not individually reviewed. If there are no stored values the response says so explicitly; never guess specifications in that case. OceanSphere does not hold stock.

designation.description: Alternative to model_ref: exact model designation (together with manufacturer).
designation.title: Designation

manufacturer.description: Alternative to model_ref: manufacturer (together with designation).
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

model_ref.description: model_ref returned by search_equipment_models or find_by_manufacturer.
model_ref.title: Model Ref

name: get_equipment_model
title: Get one model with stored values
